description:
Review baseline: release/3.0 at fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc.
Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-236c-7ba3-a07a-8bbe84647d97

1. **P1 — Commit can skip required confirmation after an actor change.**  
   [execution_authorization.ex:56](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/runtime/execution_authorization.ex:56) trusts the stored `confirmation_required?` flag. The [snapshot check](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/runtime/runtime.ex:383) does not bind the actor or check this flag again.  
   **Evidence:** Prepare a `:required_for_ai` action as a user. Commit it as an agent with the same connection, lease, and binding. The handler runs without approval. Changing a stored `:always` action’s confirmation flag to `false` also permits execution.  
   **Correction:** Bind the actor identity to the snapshot. Calculate confirmation requirements again from the current action and context. Reject an inconsistent stored flag.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: Commit can skip required confirmation after an actor change
